sections.text: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.text: Oswald Avery Jr: physician and Medical Researcher was the first to identify DNA as the molecule of inheritance
sections.title: Forgotten Superheroes of Science

sections.text:
Item #1: A new genetic study of mice finds that fathers have a greater genetic influence on their offspring than mothers.
Item #2: New research finds that regular consumption of peanuts is associated with a 23-38% decrease in cardiovascular mortality.
Item #3: Field trials on a new GMO strain of wheat with increased photosynthesis demonstrate more than double increased yield from conventional wheat hybrids.
